questions.question: Explain how React reconciliation works and when it causes performance issues.
questions.questionZh: 請說明 React reconciliation 如何運作，以及何時會造成效能問題。
questions.answerDirection: Mention virtual DOM diff, keys, memo, and a real profiling example.
questions.answerDirectionZh: 提到 virtual DOM diff、key、memo，並舉一個實際 profiling 例子。

questions.question: How would you structure data fetching in a Next.js App Router project?
questions.questionZh: 你會如何在 Next.js App Router 專案中規劃資料取得？
questions.answerDirection: Server Components vs client, caching, React Query for client mutations.
questions.answerDirectionZh: 區分 Server/Client Component、快取策略、mutation 用 React Query。

questions.question: Walk me through a feature you owned end-to-end. What tradeoffs did you make?
questions.questionZh: 請介紹一個你端到端負責的功能，以及你做過的取捨。
questions.answerDirection: STAR format: context, your role, technical decisions, measurable outcome.
questions.answerDirectionZh: 用 STAR：背景、你的角色、技術決策、可量化結果。

questions.question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you resolve it?
questions.questionZh: 請分享一次你與同事意見不合的經驗，以及如何解決。
questions.answerDirection: Focus on communication, data, and outcome — not blame.
questions.answerDirectionZh: 強調溝通、數據與結果，避免指責。

questions.question: How do you handle async communication across time zones?
questions.questionZh: 你如何處理跨時區的非同步溝通？
questions.answerDirection: Written updates, documentation, overlap hours, clear RFCs.
questions.answerDirectionZh: 書面更新、文件、重疊時段、清楚的 RFC。
